span.p:
Tab shows a dot.
A 400 ms timer starts.
Typing again resets the timer,
so we write once per pause,
not once per keystroke.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Every disk operation joins one
promise chain, so writes, renames
and deletes reach the disk in the
same order you made them.
